title: Japanese Shrimp Pilaf
description: A quick and easy Japanese-style pilaf dish loaded with succulent shrimp. Perfect for a weeknight dinner or a weekend meal.
instructions: Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add shrimp and cook until pink, about 2-3 minutes per side.
Remove shrimp from skillet and set aside.
Add pilaf to skillet and cook until lightly toasted, about 2 minutes.
Add eastern, middle, piquant, soy sauce, and sugar to skillet and stir to combine.
Return shrimp to skillet and stir to coat with pilaf mixture.
Cook for an additional 1-2 minutes, until shrimp are coated and heated through.
Stir in chopped green onions and serve immediately.
